comment: Sampling profiles for agent runs (FA-20). The first profile whose pattern matches the model key (case-insensitive regular expression) is used; `--temperature` overrides only the temperature. Every value is sent to LM Studio explicitly. Values are taken from the cited model cards or generation configs; a model without a matching profile gets the fallback.

profiles.source: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-8B (thinking mode; greedy decoding is discouraged)

fallback.source: not from a model card: temperature 0.7 by decision FA-20, the other values are common llama.cpp defaults
